stages.text: Just play the story and enjoy it. The 100% checklist is not viewable until after the story, but any progress you make during it already counts. Do optional missions as they appear, scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study new animals with the binoculars as you go — both feed the checklist later. There are no mission gold medals, so you never need to watch for hidden objectives.
stages.title: Step 1 — Finish the story
stages.warning: Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the only possibly missable trophy in the set.

stages.hours: As you go, then after the story
stages.text: Work through the open-world trophies in any order: stunts, races and drone races, shooting-range golds, collectibles, robberies, and money. Most of these feed the 100% checklist, so you are doing two jobs at once. Robberies are also the fastest money in the game and fund the garages and the $100,000 of shopping.
stages.title: Step 2 — Open-world grind
stages.warning: Bank-vault robberies need the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… first; the Key Cloner (Chapter 3) unlocks the showroom Banshee and Randy's wish list.

stages.text: After the story, open the checklist under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and finish it. The requirements are lenient — closer to 60% of true completion — and you only need 70 of the 80 challenges, so skip the hardest ones. Then finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands and anything left over.
stages.title: Step 3 — 100% checklist and cleanup
stages.warning: Nothing on the checklist is missable; everything stays doable in free-roam after the story.

stages.text: When the other 54 are earned, Vice Got a Price! pops on its own. No DLC, no multiplayer, no extra playthrough.
stages.title: Step 4 — Platinum

summary: One playthrough is enough. Roughly 200 hours in total: 60–80 hours of story, about 100 hours on the 100% checklist and challenges, then a short cleanup. There are no online trophies, no difficulty settings, and cheats disable trophies and saving — keep them off. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots) and rotate the rest for free-roam cleanup.
title: Road to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
